verdict.rationale: A live, versioned HMRC production REST API exists: the probe got a structured JSON error from api.service.hmrc.gov.uk/hello/world. HMRC's own sign-up guidance names Making Tax Digital as a sanctioned software channel, and a developer hub host exists. However, none of its documentation pages were fetched, so the story's specific elements are not shown on HMRC's own pages. missing for 10: published endpoint documentation, a documented key/credential-issuance path, stated rate limits, independent corroboration of developer-hub content.
